notes.title: Maintenance Notice, Jun 1
notes.content:
Time
14:00 - 18:00, Jun 1, 2021 (UTC+7)
The scheduled time for maintenance is subject to change.

Changes

I. Game Mode
1.New game modes: Naval Academy, Versus Mode, Marine Club, and Naval Research Lab.
2.The Naval Academy mode, including Training Field and Sim Battlefield, is meant for newcomers and casual players.
3.The Versus Mode, including Solo Ranked and Team Ranked, is meant for competitive players.
4.The Marine Club is meant for some of the hardcore players, and is unavailable during this patch. Special Mode and Premium Mode will be released in future patches.
5.The Naval Research Lab is a limited-time game mode, with lots of events to follow. When the patch launches, the Destroyer Versus Mode will be available for a limited period of time.
6.In the Destroyer Versus Mode, up to 24 players are allowed to join a single match, with 3 players in each team, and only destroyers are allowed to be used. Players are pit against one another in two factions, and can score by capturing resource points on the map. At the end of a match, the faction with higher scores claims victory and receives amazing rewards. Upon death, players can be revived before re-engaging in the battle.

II. Gameplay
1. New weather system. Weather events, e.g. clear, rainy, snowy days, have been added to the Versus Mode, with more events to come in the future. Different weather events grant warships unique statuses. For example, ships can be slowed, and main battery damage is affected by weather.
2. Instead of looting supply crates, players now have direct access to in-game items that are scattered across the seas.
3. By holding Ctrl, players can now choose to display cursor and view some of the in-game information.
4. Improved the control and prompt messages of wire-guided torpedo.
5. New in-game navigation system. Players may open the map and enable this feature.
6. Balanced warship stats.
7. Changed the storm's shrinking time in the Versus Mode and Sim Battlefield.

III. Equipment System
1. The traditional six equipment modules have been changed into four modules: Fire Control System, Defense System, Maneuvering System, and Recon System.
2. Added General Equipment category to the Fire Control System. General Equipment has no limit to the number of warships, which allows for full customization.
3. In the Fire Control System, main battery, secondary battery, and torpedo ammo now count as consumables that can be purchased out of battles or looted in battles.
4. All armaments, except the default green main battery, can only fire with loaded ammos.
5. Added a new equipment category—Control Tower
6. Added new general equipment Dumaresq (Allows players to aim at targets in advance.)
7. Removed the Torpedo Launcher module from battleships.
8. Removed the default green equipment from warships (main battery excluded).
9. Removed the equipment category Signal Flag.


IV. New Munition System
1. The new munition system includes Quick Repair Module, Intermediate Post-battle Repair System, and Advanced Urgent Recovery System.
2. Munitions can be purchased in the Store and equipped out of battle, or looted in-battle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/61c7da12084f4c15829f916b31ca67fd250d5eb6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/0b7242bdd58c5300346a39d74f72a3a5b9212670.png[/img]

V. New Rank Achievement System
The new rank achievement system allows players to earn medals of honor by completing specified achievements. Players can edit the medals of their choice. A rank display system will be launched in the follow-up updates.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/76cf18b40a235fb12b1fbc713e5b7e471413d6cd.png[/img]

VI. About Military Rank
1. The rank system is renamed "Military Rank."
2. Added promotion quests for military ranks. Upon reaching specific points, players can complete promotion quests and ascend to a higher military rank.
3. Added a guarantee system to the military rank. After players complete the promotion quest, they won't ever fall back to the original military rank.

VII. Miscellaneous
1. Other game feature, name, and UI changes
2. Improved commander Nimitz and Tirpitz
3. Improved the Lobby and in-game UI
4. Changed some of the key bindings

For any bug reports or suggestions, please join our QQ group 715186968. You may also leave your remarks in the comment section. We'll give you feedbacks as soon as possible. Thank you for your kind support as always.

notes.title: Maintenance Notice, Feb 2
notes.content:
Time
10:00 - 18:00, Feb 2, 2021 (UTC+8)
The scheduled time for maintenance is subject to change.

Changes
1.	Season 0 is over. The Season of Vanguard has begun.
Solo rank, team rank, season level, and weekly challenge quests will be reset.
The rank level and rewards are reset. In order to earn amazing rewards, players need to re-purchase the seasonal rank in the new season.

2.	In light of our subsequent design planning, the in-game warship level system is temporarily removed.

3.	Iterated the commander system. Removed some of the commanders in the previous version. The players who have unlocked these commanders will be compensated accordingly.
Six brand new commanders, each having a unique talent tree. Some of the talents will be unlocked from the beginning, while the others require further upgrades of commanders.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/6b1f12a3d11bd93ed1ee4e99bb154f52f373cf84.png[/img]

There are two categories of the talent tree: Battle Tactics and Passive Skills. Battle Tactics allows you to pick a tactic that best suits you in combat, whereas the Passive Skills don't need to be chosen again.

Commanders can be upgraded using Shared EXP, Commander Elite EXP, and Commander EXP Card.
Players may customize their battle tactics and passive skills by teaming up captains, chief mates, and second mates.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/848d559a6d7512dc855afaa4c25ce39dabb11b0a.png[/img]

Shared EXP: Shared EXP is granted at the end of each battle, which can be used to upgrade commanders.
Elite Commander EXP: Upon reaching maximum level, Commanders will be upgraded to Elite Commanders, and the subsequent battles will grant Elite Commander EXP, which, along with Battle Coins, can be exchanged for Shared EXP at a set ratio.

4.	Depot Refitted
The Store Depot, Temporary Depot, and Equipment Depot have been integrated, and the storage space has been significantly expanded.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/74f873776b306437d77c4fc264370e0608f705be.png[/img]

5.	Removed the Silver Boost Card, Commander EXP Boost Card, and Depot boost items.
6.	Added Commander EXP Card, which grants commanders EXP upon usage.
7.	Added a solo Training Mode in which there is an AI warship that helps with your commander training and harnesses your battle tactics.
8.	Added a solo Sim Battlefield mode that drops no loot, costs no equipment durability, and cannot be taken out of battles. Players will hold no punches and harness their skills.
9.	Added supply funds. When a player's silver falls below a set threshold, they will receive silver at the end of each battle.
10.	Shop features upgraded. Added an interface for Battle Coin and Rank purchase. Added a Filter function that allows players to efficiently search for the items they need. Removed Commander's War Supply.
11.	The daily online reward event is available now. During the event, players may claim their online rewards based on the period of time they've stayed in the game.
12.	Changed some UI and key mappings.

notes.title: Maintenance Notice, Jan 6
notes.content:
Time
11:00 - 15:00, Jan 6, 2021 (UTC+8)
The scheduled time for maintenance is subject to change.

Changes

1.	Removed the warship refitting system and warship level system.
2.	Removed basic post-battle repair system; removed Quick Repair Module from consumables into the Regular Skill module.
3.	Now you cannot exchange munitions for equipment in-battle. Removed the Attachment system and Load system.
4.	Introduced a new Warship Equipment system that includes six categories—"main battery," "secondary weapon," "torpedo launcher," "Engine," and "Flag."
Silver: Can be acquired from battles or exchanged with Battle Coins. You will receive a great amount of silver by completing daily quests or raising your rank.

Warship Equipment System: Players may spend silver on equipment at the Store and take it to battles. In addition, equipment can no longer be redeemed by munitions in-battle. Instead, you can acquire it by salvaging, collecting supply crates, and sinking enemy ships. At the end of a battle, based on your performance, you may choose to take out the equipment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/f188a4d14b668ca0a46837da8fa8be2cb160d1f7.png[/img]

5.	Introduced an in-battle warship level system. Players may upgrade their warships by fighting in battles and collecting resources, so that they will unlock a variety of strategies and tactical skills.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/cd150986f7d66177021dd4cb9f95e01d65f1e823.png[/img]

6.	Removed "random stores." Launched a new War Supply system.
Leader's War Supply: Contains Warship Camo, Ballistic Effects, Stern Flag, and other warship cosmetics. When active, there's a chance you will upgrade them to superior supply crates.

Commander’s War Supply: Contains Warship Camo, Ballistic Effects, Stern Flag, and other warship cosmetics.
Duplicate cosmetics will be transformed into Scrap Metal. You may exchange Scrap Metal for "Commander's War Supply" and other bonus at the Hardware Shop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/47810a1a6665b184dd9692187f6e36037339c787.png[/img]

7. Removed warship camos under the Rank category. No more warship camos will be yielded from Rank. Now Warship Camos can be obtained from War Supplies and events. More sources will be unlocked in the future.

8. Free Weekly War Supplies
In appreciation for your support, starting today, the "Free Weekly War Supplies" event will be available at the Event Center. Every week, you may claim 1 "Leader's War Supply" for free at the corresponding page.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/fd9bdfeb6643bc50ffcaf9e0114453fc7a05cc72.png[/img]

9. Introduced Epic Cosmetic Vouchers, which can be exchanged for epic cosmetics at the Store - Epic Exchange.
For now, the main source of the voucher is unlocking "Leader's War Supply." You may also acquire it from the Rank and Activity Shop. More sources will be available in the future.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/e73eafd5a5922ce1891c8d640db2cfaa05fabbf7.png[/img]

10. New Battlestar Store
Upon reaching maximum rank 50, you will unlock Exchange Battlestars. After unlocking the Battlestar Store, players may exchange their Battlestars obtained from quests and events for equipment and other rare items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/5ea95ee3d588155c4d3e6648b09de80dcfa117d5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/84023f0f831a80c53b1a11cc1ec17844343a00dd.png[/img]

11. The new Equipment Depot and Store Depot enable players to deposit their equipment and items, which allows for more options outside of battles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/894b15467d6cf303008293c3870dd65fe676d259.png[/img]

12. Introduced tutorial levels to acquaint new players with the game.

13. Introduced a Career system that allows players to upgrade their permission levels and receive amazing rewards by meeting specific requirements.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/d8298f8bbfcf46e5e7f2b11eb9abdd9ce2b2bbb7.png[/img]

14. Due to the removal of parts of the features and the addition of some new features, the daily quests, weekly challenges, and Project New Star have been revamped.

15. Prioritized the game's UI and some key bindings.

notes.content:
[b]Time[/b]
Asia: 14:00 – 17:00, July 8, 2020 (UTC+8)	
Global: 7:00 – 10:00, July 8, 2020 (UTC+1)

The scheduled time for maintenance is subject to change.

[b]Content[/b]

1.	New feature: Warship Level System
After battle, warships will receive individual experience that is used to level them up.

2. New feature: Warship Refitting System
By upgrading warships, players will unlock primary, secondary, and tweak modules that are used to customize ship stats.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/ec0b21cf362d80772e7ff7c53a4df220ccd2ecb4.jpg[/img]

3. New feature: Commander System
Commanders are endowed with 1 active skill and 3 passive skills which are unlocked by leveling up the commander. Players will receive 3 commanders by logging into the game after update and acquire 3 additional commanders by ranking up.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/8a668326e389d0ba2ee6d593817e4663c1000a32.jpg[/img]

4. New feature: Shared EXP Exchanging System
Shared EXP can be acquired from battles, or traded with Elite Warship EXP (acquired from battles when warships are at max level. Shared EXP has a wide range of usage. It is used to upgrade warships, components, as well as commanders.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/e32290ac64ef4d7b8d3e14a3126337c2176c7a21.png[/img]

5. New feature: Cruisers and destroyers' secondary weapons will receive their unique attachments.

6. The brand new "View Warship Stats" mechanic will be integrated into "Weapons & Armor Viewer," which is displayed at the "Refit Base."

7. In light of the game genre and playstyle, the "pick-up" mechanic (both solo and team mode) will be permanently removed. The Munition mode will be the current focal gameplay, which will be continuously improved later on.

8. Due to the removal of the "pick-up" system, the daily quests, weekly challenges, and Project New Star will be adjusted accordingly.

9. All combat sound effects have been reworked.

10. The beginner's tutorial and corresponding rewards have been temporarily removed for adjustment. Once improved, they will be enabled again.

11. The Help system has been temporarily removed for adjustment. Once improved, it will be enabled again.

12. Removed the ammo depletion of main battery, secondary weapons, and torpedo launchers.

13. After a purchase is made, there will be no longer any delay of item delivery. In terms of item sale, a portion of the selling price will be charged as commission.

14. The consumable "Propulsion Enhancement System" has been removed.

15. Calculation of Urgent Recovery System and Post-battle Repair System is now based on percentage value instead of specific value.

notes.title: Patch Notes 2020/04/02
notes.content:
Time
Asia: 10:00 – 16:00 (UTC+8)
Global: 3:00 – 9:00 (UTC+0)

The scheduled time for maintenance is subject to change

Feature Updates
1、	The new battle map Icy Snowfield is in full swing!
Fight to the death in the world of ice and snow. Who will be the last one standing?
The Icy Snowfield, along with the island maps, will join the random list for matchmaking.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/f899a311e27ade7fbf92ca9e44ade54a8eacf93b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/7e8e41f069542bad05dcca53dda1114eb23b15c0.jpg[/img]


2、	An all-new game mode—Munition is released
No more scavenger hunts. Instead, you will collect your munitions through combat, exploration, survival, and loots to purchase equipment, which builds up a more competitive and thrilling experience. Please feel free to give us your feedbacks and report the issues you encounter.
■ Source of munitions:
◆ Initial Reward: Initial rewards when battle begins.
◆ Natural Reward: The munitions that automatically increase over time after battle begins.
◆ First-blood Reward: Munitions rewarded to the first kill claimer in the current battle.
◆ Kill Reward: The basic rewards for getting kills (decreases as the target dies more often. Has its minimum limit. Available in revival mode)
◆ Kill Bounty: The extra bounty for killing targets. Increases as you get more kills. Has it maximum limit.
◆ Collapse Reward: Rewards for Collapsing targets.
◆ Accuracy Reward: Rewards for hitting targets based on your Medal Bars. Medal Bars include Ricochet, Not Damaged, and Too Badly Damaged, etc.
◆ Assist Reward: Rewards for Highlights and Assists. Contains a guaranteed reward.
◆ Exploration Reward: Rewards for entering other war zones.
◆ Survival Reward: Rewards for the survived players each time the storm zone stops shrinking.
◆ Airdrop Reward: When battle begins, munition supply crates are parachuted into the battlefield. Players can pick them up within range.
◆ Gifts: In team mode, munitions can be sent to teammates.
◆ Salvaging: Unneeded equipment can be dragged into the recycle section and salvaged.

■ Consumption of munitions: When battle begins, click “Tab” to open the Store menu. The selected equipment will be put in the Shopping Cart. When payment is made, the equipment will be deployed after a short delay. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/26ac48df715290df186a542729e017c26edec114.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/d885c9757a6e819c4a6ce057e09afbf106c652db.png[/img]

3、	New Profile feature
You can now view your friend’s or teammate’s personal data, including their rank and combat statistics. Of course, you can toggle the function via “Settings-Control-Personal Data.”
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/78fbf0f61b5f86facef9c0906e0350f34c0a1023.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/6736ae34c2014e548aff8249548a990c4d61bb3d.png[/img]

4. The “Assist” system
Highlighting or aiding teammates in killing will grant you “Assist” medal bars and extra points, giving you a better teamplay experience.

5. Weapons & Armor Viewer
This feature allows you to check the stats for armor and weapons in all modules to get a comprehensive view of all types of ships and develop your strategies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/ce4cb188b40512d16580adec3feb1eb432ccf42e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/c9ae6eeaa7de003bcd75bcde69eaeac0fd6bb41f.jpg[/img]

6. Scout Radius Indicator
You can now check the map for the current ship’s scout radius and other information.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/030f6c6c47f399f329dcc07967e6cd69b5214e39.png[/img]

7. Improved the camera for Artillery Smoke Bombs; changed the mechanics of how cannon fire affects scout radius; ships are automatically equipped with white secondary batteries from the start; new Kill Cards.
8. Added an independent camera for Destroyer’s “Secondary Weapon-Artillery Smoke Bomb.”
9. In the classic mode, ships are equipped with lv.1 secondary weapons from the start by default.
10. Improved killing feedback. When killed, you can now see the killer’s Avatar, Card, and Frame.
11. Improved the mechanics of “how cannon fire affects scout radius.” After firing, scout radius is now same as your main battery range.


For any bug reports or suggestions, please join our QQ group 715186968. You can also leave your remarks in the comment section. We’ll give you feedbacks as soon as possible. Thank you for your warm support.

2、	The warship's weapon has a different number of slots depending on its quality, which can be acquired on the sea for installing and further enhance the weapon's propertied.

The number of slots is associated with weapon quality. The current version has a maximum of 2 slots.
The current version has 5 equipment with different attributes.
The main gun, torpedo-launching weapon and secondary weapon (currently only the secondary weapon of Battleship can be installed. After that it will be added for Cruiser and Destroyer)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603411/2da4a8eeb8012238c1ff6702ae32fa44c16bfdb5.jpg[/img]

3、	There will be new types of player costumes in the game - business cards, business card frames and matchup avatars. They not only provide a more personal match for the player, but also trigger a battlefield display in battle based on specific conditions.
